features: Blaupunkt is an iconic German brand that has developed cutting edge audio technology since 1924. Today this legendary Audio Tech German brand is available in India with a wide range of Audio Products.
Powerful 20W RMS Output – Experience superior sound performance, crafted with German engineering by Blaupunkt, a trusted 100-year-old brand known for audio excellence.
Powerful Driver and Passive Radiator – Blaupunkt advanced acoustic design delivers deep bass and crisp highs, offering unmatched clarity and power in every beat.
Long-Lasting Battery – Enjoy hours of uninterrupted playback with Blaupunkt energy-efficient technology, perfect for long outdoor adventures.
Dynamic RGB Lights – Enhance your audio experience with visually engaging RGB lights, reflecting Blaupunkt innovative design philosophy.
Ideal Boombox for Outdoor Use– Combining German precision with rugged design, Blaupunkt’s speaker is the ultimate companion for outdoor gatherings and adventures.
